items.title: Revenge of the Baskerville Bloodhound
items.description:
Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Vikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father’s hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Vikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he's ready to bite the hand that feeds.

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Novel's Extra
items.description:
Wouldn’t it be a dream to wake up in a world of your own creation? For Kim Hajin, it’s nothing short of a nightmare. With no clue how or why he’s been transported into his web novel — as a mere extra, no less! — Hajin has little choice but to see his story through until the end. Lucky for him, as the author, he knows this perilous world like the back of his hand. But when discrepancies in the plot begin popping up left and right, Hajin soon realizes that things aren’t quite so simple, after all…

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
items.description:
Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2
items.description:
Earth lost the fight for survival in the BattleNet system and humanity now faces eradication. However, Jihan Seong is given another chance. He has returned three years into the past before BattleNet became a life-or-death game. With his knowledge of the future, he’s determined to become the strongest player. Will Jihan be able to change the fate of humanity? And more importantly, can he protect the ones he loves from those who want him to fail?

(Source: Tapas)

items.title: The Tutorial Is Too Tough!
items.description:
Lee Ho-Jae had given up his life as a pro gamer, until one day he received a mysterious message:

“Congratulations! You’ve been invited to the Tutorial World.”

Intrigued, he enters the game and confidently chooses “hell” difficulty, but soon learns that he is trapped there. With a mere 0.01% survival rate, Ho-Jae must somehow overcome the game’s agonizing challenges to figure out the real reason he was invited. This tutorial may be tough, but its secrets are what’s truly hellacious.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

items.title: Absolute Regression
items.description:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Absolute Sword Sense
items.description:
For as long as he can remember, Woonhwi So has been the black sheep of his family and clan. Because his spirit core has been destroyed, he has no choice but to serve as a third-rate spy for the Blood Cult. One day, during his mission to find the legendary Blade Scroll, he is killed and sent 10 years into the past. When Woonhwi regains consciousness, he realizes that he has been sent back to the day he was kidnapped by the Blood Cult, and that he has gained a mysterious ability to hear the voice of a dagger.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
items.description:
Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Sichuan Tang Clan’s Entomologist
items.description:
Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics.

"I see potential in you. Become a part of our family."

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Shepherd Wizard
items.description:
Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him. But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital and embrace the destiny he was meant for?

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua
items.description:
After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

(Source: WEBTOON)

items.title: Bangnanggisaro Saraganeun Beop
items.description:
After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family. He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society. “The only person you can trust is yourself.” In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power. While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild. This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

items.title: Naega Jugin Dragon-gwa Gyeolhonhaetda
items.description:
The pinnacle of magic was the 9th Circle, a realm said to be that of a demigod. The final key to reaching it was the heart of the Crimson Dragon, Valdrova.

“I never imagined my own fiancé would come to kill me.”

Yet for some reason, Valdrova offered up her heart without putting up any resistance.

“…What is this feeling? Why does this leave such a bitter taste?”

Then I faced it—a despair far older and deeper than the hatred I had carried.

(Source: Naver, translated)
